# gitmoap_group_tag_rule (Resource)

Protects the matching tags of every repository beneath the group, unless a repository or a nearer group declares its own rule for the same pattern — or, with `enforcement: enforced`, holds them all to at least this level whatever they declare, which only an Owner of the group may set. Maintainers and above may create a rule; a pattern takes one rule per group.

The token needs `tag_rule:manage` and `tag_rule:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group's id
- `tag_pattern` (String) The tags a tag rule protects: one tag name, or a glob over tag names such as `v*` or `release-*`.

### Optional

- `allowed_to_create` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created.
- `scope_id` (String) The repository or group the rule is attached to.
- `scope_type` (String)
- `tag_rule_id` (String) A tag rule's id: one protected tag pattern on a repository or a group.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id and tag_rule_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_group_tag_rule.example "<group_id>/<tag_rule_id>"
```
